creator: Codex-authored indexed pixel drawings for Edgefall
reference: Original Quay Watch / Breakwater / Kestrel designs; shared Edgefall native-pixel scale and palette discipline, no sampled third-party pixels.
notes: Kestrel is an original compact teal amphibious tractor with warm tread rollers, slab armor and a separate eight-direction turret.
Chassis, tread phase, turret and hatch/crew are separate native layers. Turret headings follow world aim and do not inherit hull facing.
Boarding and exit hatch acting sample the accepted 12/8-tick seat action. The simulation alone transfers ownership and places the occupant.

Literal native pixels include stride-independent track motion, airborne suspension, grounded compression and a bounded inert wreck. Further crew/ejection acting and human weight/readability review remain open.
